_about: Pages the ledger watches because they have no API. Each run compares what the page lists now with data/watch/<name>.json and reports what is new. mode links: hrefs matching pattern (and keywords if given); mode sentences: sentences containing a keyword and a digit (a changed figure shows as a new sentence); mode probe: whether a URL built from a template for a year exists.

pages.name: va_deq_datacenter_permits
pages.action: New or replaced permit documents on DEQ's datacenter list: download by browser, run pipeline/run_all.sh with --pdf-dir, read twice, add to va_permits_resolved.csv.

pages.name: pjm_las_materials
pages.action: New load-forecast submissions: read Dominion, NOVEC and co-op datacenter figures into sites/metered/va_class_transcribed.csv and map them in filed_figures_curated.csv.

pages.name: grant_pud_datacenter_faq
pages.action: A changed datacenter sentence: update us-wa-grant-pud-datacenter-load-2025 and public_power_transcribed.csv.

pages.name: srp_datacenter_facts
pages.action: A changed datacenter sentence: update public_power_transcribed.csv.

pages.name: cso_datacentre_release
pages.action: A new CSO annual release: update ie-national-cso-share-2025 (new entry for the year) and the Irish share in METERED.md.
